title: Understanding the Implementation of Technical Measures in the Process of Data Privacy Compliance: A Qualitative Study
reasoning: The paper focuses on a qualitative study of the implementation of technical measures for data privacy compliance, particularly related to GDPR, from legal and engineering perspectives. While data privacy has ethical dimensions, the study does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as its primary subject.
